records.issue_text: absolutize_urls rewrites only root-relative URLs, so ordinary relative links and image sources resolve against the embed URL rather than the source article
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a limitation in the absolutize_urls method in topic_embed.rb. Looking at lines 53-68, the method only handles URLs that start_with?('/'), meaning root-relative URLs like '/hello' or '/images/wat.jpg'.
